study.title: On-Edge Weed Detection Using Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
study.short_title: On-Edge U-Net Weed Detection on Jetson Nano (CoFly-WeedDB)

models_tested: U-Net + multispectral band (H / LAP / NDI / ExR / CIVE)
segmentation.best_model: U-Net with RGB+Hue (4 bands), 640 training samples (IoU 0.5212, Dice 0.6736)

dataset.name: CoFly-WeedDB (cotton field, Larissa, Greece)
dataset.note: Public CoFly-WeedDB: 366 RGB images via DJI Phantom 4, 5 m altitude, 3 m/s, 1280x720 px, 3 weed types (Johnson grass, field bindweed, purslane); masks imprecise (included soil/crop) so manually relabeled with Label Studio after dropping empty images -> 201 images, split 80/10/10 train/val/test; augmentation (horizontal flip, random crop, grid distortion) at 3 levels producing 160/320/480/640 training samples; GSD 0.63 cm/px estimated for RPi camera V2 at 5 m.

segmentation.backbone: Custom lightweight U-Net (encoder-decoder, optional gated attention), consumer-grade RGB + derived bands (2G-R+B, 1.4R-G, CIVE, NDI, OSAVI, HSV, Sobel/Laplacian/Canny)

mIoU.quote: RGB + H (4) 640 U-Net IoU 0.5212 (F32); IoU above 50%
mIoU.ambiguity: Best configuration RGB+Hue with 640 training samples. RGB-only (480 samples) reaches IoU 0.5192; U-Net+Attention RGB 640 IoU 0.4926. FP16 quantization preserves IoU 0.5212 (RGB+H 640).

F1.ambiguity: Binary weed Dice (=F1) reported separately under Dice.

Dice.quote: RGB + H (4) 640 U-Net Dice 0.6736 (F32); Dice exceeding 60%
Dice.ambiguity: Best configuration RGB+Hue (640 samples). RGB-only 480: Dice 0.6721; U-Net+Attention 640: 0.6473. FP16: 0.6735.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Binary weed-vs-background Dice 0.6736 (captured under Dice) serves as weed-class F1.

crop_F1.ambiguity: No crop class: masks relabeled to weed vs background only.

edge.device: Nvidia Jetson Nano (4 GB LPDDR4, 128-core Maxwell GPU, 16 Gb board)
edge.precision: FP16 (TensorRT); FP16 quantization also via TF-Lite

fps.ambiguity: Measured on Jetson Nano. TensorRT processing optimized via weight pruning + FP16 quantization; negligible accuracy loss (0.005-0.01%). Max model FPS ~2 => ideal drone speed 16.08 m/s at 5 m; required FPS for typical drone speeds 0.12-0.62. U-Net+Attention 1.862, U-Net+MS 1.844 FPS.

latency_ms.quote: U-Net (Tensor-RT) inference time 0.5366 s; TF-Lite 3.6858 s
latency_ms.ambiguity: Jetson Nano, 1280x720 (image-based inference, no patching reported). TensorRT ~0.54 s vs TF-Lite ~3.6 s.

power_w.ambiguity: Measured by averaging current draw (Yocto-Amp) at 5 V supply during inference on Jetson Nano. U-Net+Attention 4.760 W, U-Net+MS 4.861 W. TensorRT trades ~0.2 W for ~6x faster inference vs TF-Lite.

issues: Preprint, not peer-reviewed (SSRN; submitted to Internet of Things journal). Worklist screening = PROVISIONAL_FULLTEXT_ELIGIBILITY (abstract unavailable at screening; EXC-06); full-text verification confirms quantitative on-edge results do exist.
Mask relabelling is manual; classes binary weed-vs-background (no crop class).
Model input resolution not explicitly stated (images 1280x720; no patching mentioned).
